title.es: The Repair Café That Changed a Neighbourhood
title.en: The Repair Café That Changed a Neighbourhood

intro.es: Practica inglés B1 con un artículo sobre reparación, aprendizaje entre generaciones y comunidad.
intro.en: Practise B1 English with an article about repair, intergenerational learning, and community.

mission.es: Explica cómo creció el proyecto, por qué incluso una reparación fallida puede servir y qué cambio comunitario ocurrió.
mission.en: Explain how the project grew, why even a failed repair can help, and what community change occurred.

content.targetText: Every second Saturday, the basement of a public library in Toronto fills with broken lamps, silent radios, torn backpacks, and people who do not want to throw them away. The event is called a repair café, although it sells neither repairs nor coffee. Volunteers with practical skills sit beside the owners and try to understand what has gone wrong. The owners are expected to watch, ask questions, and help. The project began when local resident Amira Khan noticed how many small appliances appeared on the street before rubbish collection day. She invited three neighbours to repair objects in her garage. Twenty people arrived at the first meeting, and the garage quickly became too small. The library offered its basement, while a nearby bakery began donating drinks and bread. Not everything can be saved. Some devices need unavailable parts, and volunteers refuse to open equipment that may be dangerous. Even unsuccessful repairs can be useful, however, because owners learn why an object failed and how to buy a longer-lasting replacement. Over two years, the group has examined more than eight hundred items and repaired about sixty percent of them. Amira believes the numbers tell only part of the story. Teenagers have learned sewing from retired neighbours, newcomers have practised English while fixing bicycles, and people who once came with broken objects now return as volunteers. The café has therefore become less about saving individual products and more about sharing knowledge that a neighbourhood already possesses.

objectives.es: Comprender desarrollo, resultados y significado social en un artículo.
objectives.en: Understand development, results, and social meaning in an article.

objectives.es: Interpretar contraste y reformulación en una conclusión.
objectives.en: Interpret contrast and reframing in a conclusion.

glosses.en: able to remain useful for more time

culturalNote.es: El proyecto y sus cifras son ficticios, inspirados en el formato comunitario general de los repair cafés, sin atribuir resultados a una organización real.
culturalNote.en: The project and figures are fictional, inspired by the general community repair-café format without attributing results to a real organisation.

spanishSpeakerNote.es: Eventually no significa eventualmente en este texto; la conclusión usa therefore, que expresa por lo tanto.
spanishSpeakerNote.en: Spanish speakers: therefore means por lo tanto and signals a conclusion based on earlier evidence.

targetCanDo.es: Puedes comprender cómo un artículo conecta hechos, resultados y una conclusión social.
targetCanDo.en: You can understand how an article connects facts, results, and a social conclusion.

independentAssessment.assessor: Independent editorial preflight — human confirmation pending
independentAssessment.notes: Accessible feature article with chronological development, contrast, statistics, and a supported social inference.

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly showing?

options.text: How to open a profitable repair business
How repairing objects can also build community
Why libraries should replace books with workshops

correct.es: Correcto. La reparación se convierte en intercambio de conocimiento y vínculos.
correct.en: Correct. Repair develops into knowledge sharing and stronger connections.

incorrect.es: Compara el inicio sobre objetos con la conclusión sobre conocimiento.
incorrect.en: Compare the opening about objects with the conclusion about knowledge.

strategy.es: La idea principal suele unir el ejemplo concreto con la conclusión más amplia.
strategy.en: The main idea often connects a concrete example with the broader conclusion.

questions.evidence: Less about saving individual products and more about sharing knowledge.

questions.prompt: Why is the name repair café slightly surprising?

options.text: It sells neither repairs nor coffee.

correct.es: Correcto. El nombre no describe una venta de reparación ni de café.
correct.en: Correct. The name does not describe selling repairs or coffee.

incorrect.es: Busca la oración con although y neither.
incorrect.en: Find the sentence with although and neither.

strategy.es: Although introduce un contraste con la expectativa creada por el nombre.
strategy.en: Although introduces a contrast with the expectation created by the name.

questions.evidence: Although it sells neither repairs nor coffee.

questions.prompt: Why did the project move to the library?

correct.es: Correcto. Llegaron veinte personas y el garaje quedó pequeño.
correct.en: Correct. Twenty people came and the garage became too small.

incorrect.es: Relaciona la asistencia a la primera reunión con el cambio de lugar.
incorrect.en: Connect attendance at the first meeting with the change of venue.

strategy.es: La causa puede aparecer en una oración inmediatamente anterior a la solución.
strategy.en: A cause may appear immediately before its solution.

questions.evidence: Twenty people arrived ... the garage quickly became too small.

questions.prompt: How can an unsuccessful repair still help an owner?

options.text: The owner receives a free new device.
The owner learns about the failure and future choices.
The volunteer sells the broken parts.

correct.es: Correcto. Entiende la falla y puede elegir un reemplazo más duradero.
correct.en: Correct. The owner understands the failure and can choose a longer-lasting replacement.

incorrect.es: Lee la explicación después de because.

strategy.es: Una reparación puede evaluarse por el aprendizaje, no solo por el objeto reparado.
strategy.en: A repair can be evaluated by learning, not only by the repaired object.

questions.evidence: Owners learn why an object failed and how to buy a longer-lasting replacement.

questions.prompt: Put these stages of the project in order.

options.text: Amira invites neighbours to her garage.

correct.es: Correcto. La secuencia muestra crecimiento y participación.
correct.en: Correct. The sequence shows growth and participation.

incorrect.es: Sigue el proyecto desde su inicio hasta el resultado social final.
incorrect.en: Follow the project from its beginning to the final social result.

strategy.es: Combina pasado simple para el origen con presente perfecto para los cambios acumulados.
strategy.en: Combine past simple for the origin with present perfect for accumulated change.

questions.evidence: Garage → library basement → return as volunteers.
